name: Seoul Bike Sharing Demand Dataset
description: The Seoul Bike Sharing Demand dataset contains 8,760 hourly instances of public bicycle rental counts from the Seoul municipal bike-sharing system paired with meteorological features over a full one-year period (December 2017 to November 2018). Donated to the UCI Machine Learning Repository (DOI: 10.24432/C5F62R), the dataset incorporates 13 features: temperature, humidity, wind speed, visibility, dew point temperature, solar radiation, snowfall, rainfall, season, holiday indicators, and system functional status to forecast urban bike-sharing demand under fluctuating weather conditions.
